name: reorder_three_step_swap
transcript_text:
Carol: In the Release Checklist, run the smoke tests before the database migration, not after.
Dan: Agreed, smoke tests first then migration.

confluence_workspace_pages.title: Release Checklist
confluence_workspace_pages.content_html:
Steps

  1. Tag the release commit.
  2. Run the database migration.
  3. Run the smoke tests.
  4. Announce the release.
